material.acceptance_criteria: OWN_FILL and NEUTRAL_FILL (ui_minimap.js:10-11) reach at least 3:1 against each other, or a non-colour cue (outline or ring) marks own units, so own and neutral units are distinguishable without relying on size.
material.description: Principle DADA_CRAP (Contrast). OWN_FILL #ffffff (js/client/ui_minimap.js:11) and NEUTRAL_FILL #c2c8ce (ui_minimap.js:10) have a WCAG relative-luminance contrast of 1.69:1, below the 3:1 non-text threshold (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11). The two are told apart mainly by size: own creeps draw at 5 px through sizeFor (ui_minimap.js:22-24, own || hero), neutral creeps at 3 px. Witness: codesearch dispatch 1792858709793-5767-ab6825f62c68d61c.

notes.note: Triage refute (principle-only, no observable failure). The 1.69:1 figure compares OWN_FILL #ffffff with NEUTRAL_FILL #c2c8ce (ui_minimap.js:10-11) against each other; WCAG 1.4.11 measures each graphic against its adjacent background, and both pass on BACKGROUND #1a2129 (ui_minimap.js:17): own 16.24:1, neutral 9.62:1 (WCAG relative luminance, computed in gm_codemode). The two dots also differ by size (own 5 px via sizeFor :22-24, neutral 3 px via SIZE.creep :8), so neither is identified by colour alone. No player-visible failure is shown. Read: ui_minimap.js 8-24 dispatch 1792859769608-6581-cef0c3d1d16a4a (session verify-DADA_CRAP-trav-minimap-camera-2).

material.resolution: Stale: the premise (1.69:1 between own and neutral fills is a WCAG non-text failure) is refuted; both fills pass 3:1 against the background, and the pair differs by size.
material.subject: Own and neutral units on the minimap differ by 1.69:1 luminance contrast
material.witness: ui_minimap.js:8-24: SIZE {hero 5, creep 3}, NEUTRAL_FILL #c2c8ce, OWN_FILL #ffffff, BACKGROUND #1a2129 (:17), sizeFor (:22-24). WCAG 1.4.11 contrast vs background: own 16.24:1, neutral 9.62:1; own vs neutral 1.69:1 is not the measured criterion, and the two differ by size.
material.witness_plan: Compute the WCAG contrast of the two constants at ui_minimap.js:10-11 (expect at least 3:1 after the change); a live screenshot of a minimap with one own and one neutral unit of equal size shows them distinguishable.
